request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:RAIDER

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: cheerful sugary confectionery, bright, glossy and silly. Its fixed colours: glossy cotton-candy pink sugar glaze and frosting, colour #ffb8d8, shaded with a deeper rose pink #e58fb5; matte marshmallow white and cream; warm caramel, pale biscuit wafer and dark chocolate brown; one hard pure white highlight on every glossy surface; a few tiny pastel sprinkles and a little pale mint green trim.
layers.negative: red, crimson, magenta, hot pink, neon pink, purple, violet, hazard yellow, gold, bright orange, blue, cyan, bright green, lime, jade, metal armour, steel, iron, sword, fur, bone, skull, scary, horror, realistic, banana guard, gumball machine guardian statue, pink-haired princess, lab coat with a crown, peppermint butler, lemon-headed figure, Adventure Time

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute toy-like machine map piece, a single vehicle or device with big simple rounded shapes and one oversized signature feature, thick single-colour black outline; the whole machine is visible, and its lowest part is the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: Donut Racer, a chunky cute rider on a rolling donut: one big fat ring donut standing upright on its edge like a wheel, of golden biscuit-brown dough with thick glossy cotton-candy pink frosting, colour #ffb8d8, dripping over its top half, a few tiny pastel sprinkles and a round hole in its middle; sitting astride the top of the donut, one small living candy-corn sweet, a little cone-shaped rider with a white pointed tip, a pale peach middle and a caramel brown base, with two black dot eyes and a wide grin, leaning forward with two tiny arms holding thin dark chocolate reins; two short white speed lines behind the donut; the donut is much bigger than its rider; simple shapes and very few details; the bottom of the donut is the lowest thing in the image.
The donut is drawn large: it fills most of the width of the image and stands on its edge like a wheel, seen from its side so its hole shows.
layers.negative: bicycle, motorbike, car, kart, cart, horse, wolf, wheels with spokes, human, person, child, helmet, flat donut lying down, plate, bright orange, bright yellow
